headline: Flyers' Matvei Michkov has not requested a trade: Source
take:
The Athletic reports that Matvei Michkov has not requested a trade, while Daily Faceoff, citing ESPN's Kevin Weekes, says Michkov would be interested in a new start away from the Flyers, and that GM Daniel Briere has "no plan" to trade him.

The ice-time number is the first thing to notice. Michkov has 10 goals in 20 games, but his own expected goals (the quality of his chances) total 5.52, so he is scoring about 4.5 goals above what those chances suggest. That pace is unlikely to hold, though his role is also limited at 15.9 minutes a game. His five-on-five share of expected goals is 40.5%, and PHI's share is 2.68 points better with him off the ice, so he has not been driving play so far this season. PHI as a whole has 43.7% of the expected goals and sits at 5-10-5, which is a harder problem than one winger. A trade request is not the real issue here. A young scorer on a team that is being outplayed is, and our numbers say the results are running ahead of the process.
